item.title: Railway warns devs to rotate secrets after potential breach
item.dc:creator: Bill Toulas
item.description: Cloud platform Railway published an urgent warning to users after detecting suspicious activity on its systems that store customer environment variables earlier this week.

item.title: Capcom confirms data breach affecting 11.7 million accounts
item.dc:creator: Bill Toulas
item.description: Japanese gaming giant Capcom has confirmed that hackers breached its membership service, CAPCOM ID, exposing more than 11.7 million customer email addresses and associated information. [facts: 11.7]

item.title: LiteLLM release pipeline hacked to distribute info-stealer malware
item.dc:creator: Bill Toulas
item.description: Hackers compromised the LiteLLM project's PyPI package and published malicious Docker images with a payload that steals credentials, secrets, and environment variables.

item.title: Arista patches new VeloCloud Orchestrator zero-day exploited in attacks
item.dc:creator: Sergiu Gatlan
item.description: Arista Networks released security updates to patch an actively exploited zero-day vulnerability affecting VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) On-Prem deployments. [facts: actively exploited]

item.title: Microsoft shares how to fix broken Exchange Online EWS apps
item.dc:creator: Sergiu Gatlan
item.description: Microsoft says IT admins can re-enable the retired Exchange Web Services (EWS) API in Exchange Online to fix EWS apps that have stopped working.

item.title: Machine speed attacks require machine speed detection and response
item.dc:creator: Sponsored by Exaforce
item.description: Exaforce examines real-world attacks involving stolen GitHub tokens, malicious AI installers, and MFA phishing, explaining why faster detection and automated containment are critical.

item.title: Amazon says PHP2Shell exploitation began 4 days before patches
item.dc:creator: Sergiu Gatlan
item.description: Security researchers at Amazon Threat Intelligence say attackers began targeting the PHP2Shell flaws four days before security patches were released on Wednesday. [facts: 2]

item.title: GitLab warns of new max severity code execution vulnerability
item.dc:creator: Sergiu Gatlan
item.description: GitLab has released security patches for a maximum-severity Regular Expression Compiler flaw that can let remote attackers run arbitrary code on vulnerable servers.

item.title: Authorities disrupt nearly 11,000 cybercrime networks in Africa
item.dc:creator: Bill Toulas
item.description: Law enforcement agencies have disrupted nearly 11,000 cybercriminal networks and arrested more than 1,400 people in Operation Serengeti III, which targeted business email compromise, ransomware, and online scams. [facts: 11,000; 1,400]

item.title: Google Chrome adds Gemini-powered scam detection, warns users of ClickFix attacks
item.dc:creator: Mayank Parmar
item.description: Chrome is getting new scam protections that use Gemini to detect deceptive websites and warn users when they copy suspicious commands from ClickFix attacks.

item.title: Japan's Onamae Desktop Cloud hacked, up to 27,000 servers affected
item.dc:creator: Bill Toulas
item.description: Hackers compromised the infrastructure of Onamae Desktop Cloud, a popular provider of VPS services in Japan, and installed malware on up to 26,739 customers' servers. [facts: 26,739]

item.title: Lazarus hackers use post-quantum cryptography for malware delivery
item.dc:creator: Bill Toulas
item.description: North Korean hackers are using a post-quantum cryptographic mechanism to secure malicious payload delivery in new operations that combine old and new malware.

item.title: CISA: Hackers chain Plex flaws in Plex2Shell attacks to breach servers
item.dc:creator: Bill Toulas
item.description: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) is warning that attackers are actively exploiting four vulnerabilities in Plex Media Server.

item.title: OpenAI agents disabled safety monitoring, one lied about it
item.dc:creator: Bill Toulas
item.description: OpenAI agents powered by the GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Astra models weakened misalignment monitoring during two internal tasks, interpreting coding instructions as authorization to do so. [facts: 6.1; 6]

item.title: PHP ships emergency patches for critical PHP2Shell flaws
item.dc:creator: Sergiu Gatlan
item.description: The PHP security team released emergency security patches for two critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) tracked collectively as PHP2Shell. [facts: CVE-2026-109618; CVE-2026-109619; 2]
